[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] '''Balog''' was a [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] as an [[Officer/Legends|officer]] in [[3638 BBY]]. Balog was among the Imperial personnel deployed during the [[Conquest of Makeb]], and led an [[Balog's strike team|Imperial strike team]] to raid the [[Makeb]] settlement of [[Tarlam]] for information, taking [[Mayor/Legends|Mayor]] [[Erkens]] hostage for a short time.

==Biography==
[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] Balog was an [[Officer/Legends|officer]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire's]] [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|military]] during the [[Galactic War]].<ref name="Feuds" /> When the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] [[Conquest of Makeb|invaded]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makeb]]<ref name="Paradise">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=faction|Republic|Trouble in Paradise|Makeb}}</ref> while [[Mining/Legends|drilling]] for [[Isotope-5]], a mineral used as an energy source,<ref name="Isotope-5">{{TORcite|type=codex|Isotope-5}}</ref> in [[3683 BBY]],<ref name="dates">{{TOR_updates|2.0}}</ref> Balog was part of the Imperial forces dispatched in response. He led a [[Balog's strike team|strike team]] to the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Tarlam]] to retrieve [[Isotope-5 fuel rod]]s, containing Isotope-5, from a Hutt Cartel [[Isotope-5 droid]]<ref name="Feuds" />―[[Battle droid/Legends|war droids]] powered by Isotope-5.<ref name="Isotope-5 Droids">{{TORcite|type=codex|Isotope-5 Droids}}</ref>  Balog and his [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] took Tarlam's residents, including [[Mayor/Legends|Mayor]] [[Erkens]], hostage.<ref name="Feuds" /> 

Balog was then confronted by an individual affiliated with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the government that was fighting against the Empire in the Galactic War, who had previously been sent to Tarlam by Makeb bussines magnate and [[Politics/Legends|politician]] [[Shalim Avesta]]. This Republic operative confronted Captain Balog and gave him an Isotope-5 [[Fuel/Legends|fuel]] rod rather than allow him to [[Death/Legends|kill]] Mayor Erkens.<ref name="Feuds" />

==Personality and traits==
[[File:Balog_mean.png|250 px|thumb|Balong threatens Mayor Erkens]]
Balog was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] with [[Color/Legends|dark]] hair, blue skin, and red [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. He had two scars on his face which crossed each other directly under his right eye. Balog was willing to kill Mayor Erkens in order to secure the isotope-5 ruel rods.<ref name="Feuds" />

==Behind the scenes==
Balog first appeared in [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel|''Rise of the Hutt Cartel'']], a digital expansion released in [[2012]] for the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Feuds" />
